incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: SEV-HIGH — tenant NimbusBank (dedicated-pool-vpc-lon-2) experiencing elevated tail latency and intermittent 502s. Alert: `inference.latency.p99 > 1.0s` for 5m. Root thread ts=1767251849

natalie (oncall): I'm on it. Pulling pool health now and checking recent autoscaler events. Anyone with quick access to node metrics?

marco (eng-runtime): grabbing node metrics and last 15m logs. Running: `rcli pool inspect --name dedicated-pool-vpc-lon-2 --since 15m`

marco (eng-runtime): snippet:```
[10:20:13] ERROR decoder mem growth request_id=nb-442
[10:20:14] WARN replica-2 lost connection to grpc
[10:21:02] INFO autoscaler removed replica-2 (oom-detected)
[10:21:45] ERROR request id=nb-447 duration=2.1s status=502
```

dee (eng-sre): Confirmed autoscaler removed replica-2 after repeated OOMs. Pool currently at 2 replicas (min=1, desired=3 before removal). Looks like node gpu-lon-4 had local memory fragmentation.

natalie (oncall): Immediate mitigations proposed: 1) temporarily set min-replicas=2 to avoid aggressive scale-down; 2) instantiate a hot spare on `gpu-large-1` and add to pool; 3) enable tenant-scoped degraded routing for NimbusBank to `model-nq-quantized` (lower mem). Approve?

marco (eng-runtime): +1. I'll provision hot spare: `rcli replica create --pool dedicated-pool-vpc-lon-2 --type gpu-large-1 --label hot-temp` (ETA ~40s). Also can push a runtime guard to cap decoder alloc per request to 380MB for this pool only.

dee (eng-sre): I'll hold autoscaler: `policy:set --pool dedicated-pool-vpc-lon-2 --min-replicas 2 --autoscale-down disabled-temp` and keep it for 30m.

rachel (support): Drafting initial customer note for NimbusBank private channel. I'll paste here before sending.

natalie (oncall): Marco, after hot spare is up, route 30% of new sessions to it to drain queue. Dee, watch for any more OOMs and collect full heap profiles.

marco (eng-runtime): Hot spare `replica-hot-877` is up and healthy. Routing rule applied: `traffic-split: pool:replica-hot-877=30%`

marco (eng-runtime): Runtime guard deployed to pool-scoped config. Patch details: `decoder.max_alloc=380MB` for pool dedicated-pool-vpc-lon-2. Rolling restart not required, applies to new requests.

dee (eng-sre): Captured heap profiles and request traces to s3 `s3://inc-evidence/1767251849/`. Command used: `rcli collect --pool dedicated-pool-vpc-lon-2 --profiles heap,trace --out s3://inc-evidence/1767251849/`

rachel (support): Draft to NimbusBank: "We've detected latency spikes in your dedicated pool in LON. Our on-call identified a replica experiencing memory growth leading to an OOM and subsequent autoscaler removal; we've added capacity and enabled a quantized fallback for your traffic. We'll follow up with an RCA within 72 hours. Monitoring continues." Want to send?

natalie (oncall): Send now. Keep reply channel to this thread and cc tom for exec updates.

tom (acct-exec): Noted. NimbusBank will want SLA impact numbers and an exec-friendly summary. I'll ask for a post-incident call; please include me in the RCA review. Also they asked in DM about credits — don't commit anything until Legal confirms.

jane (legal): I'll review the contract language for the Dedicated SLA. If uptime breach is confirmed, Finance/legal will compute credits; we'll need the precise outage window and user-visible impact metrics.

marco (eng-runtime): Preliminary root-cause hypothesis: decoder memory spike likely triggered by a model tokenizer edge-case on a large batched request pattern; memory fragmentation on that node prevented allocator reuse and led to OOM. Note: NimbusBank is pinned to `model-3.2` non-quantized. We'll validate against traces.

dee (eng-sre): Impact metrics (prelim): between 10:20 and 10:28 UTC ~12% of requests for NimbusBank saw latency >800ms; 18 requests returned 502 due to failover to CPU path when replica crashed. No data exfiltration.

natalie (oncall): Agree. Next operational items: - keep autoscale-down disabled for 30m - keep hot replica for 45m - monitor p99 and errors for 1h - collect any customer-submitted request IDs for correlation

marco (eng-runtime): I'll start a limited runtime hotfix: 1) pool-scoped decoder cap (done), 2) add a small GC hint for allocator (will roll in next 48h), 3) longer-term: update autoscaler to treat node OOM as transient and require 2 consecutive failures before removing replica.

rachel (support): Sent update to NimbusBank channel. Copy: "Update: mitigation applied; added capacity and routed to fallback. We're monitoring; RCA within 72h. Thank you for bearing with us." They replied with :ok_hand: and asked for an ETA on the RCA.

natalie (oncall): Owners for follow-ups: Marco (root cause + runtime fix writeup), Dee (metrics appendix + infra actions), Rachel (customer comms), Tom (exec summary & SLA liaison), Jane (legal/credits). Create internal incident ticket and link evidence bucket.

dee (eng-sre): Ticket INC-2026-1767251849 created. Evidence: `s3://inc-evidence/1767251849/`. Internal postmortem scheduled in 48h.

marco (eng-runtime): I'll draft the technical RCA and include stack traces/heap profiles. Initial finding: one request pattern with 10k tokens after tokenization triggered decoder path expansion. We'll test reproducer in staging with model-3.2 pinned.

rachel (support): I'll coordinate the 60m stability note once metrics show p99 back to normal. Current p99 after mitigations: 0.42s (baseline ~0.35s). Monitoring window ongoing.

natalie (oncall): Incident status: mitigated at 10:29:12 UTC — hot spare handling load and p99 recovered to acceptable levels. Monitoring for recurrence for 1h. If stable, we'll transition to post-incident workstream.

tom (acct-exec): For NimbusBank leadership: preparing an exec note offering two options: (A) apply SLA credit if monthly SLO triggers, or (B) offer a goodwill upgrade package (one month free Dedicated monitoring). Will not commit until Legal signs off.

jane (legal): I'll pull contract and advise on language; expect guidance within business day.

natalie (oncall): Thanks team. Action items recap saved to ticket. Keep thread for any follow-ups. If anyone finds evidence of model regressions or reproducible input patterns, ping Marco directly.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Status changed to MITIGATED by natalie at 1767252552. Monitoring window ends at 1767256152.
note: This thread captures an incident involving a customer-specific dedicated pool (VPC). Contains root messages, mitigation steps, evidence paths, and owners for RCA and customer comms. Follow-up required for SLA/credit decisions.
